agent_priors_used: Local optima and path dependence: strong retrieval without parameterization prematurely converges to literal replay; exhaustive exploration wastes cost on known structure — motivates explicit novelty budgeting and testing residual-novelty tracking (SPIDER prior, not SPIDER evidence)

Planning horizon and error accumulation: long-horizon agents (>15 steps) compound early tool-choice errors and self-generated subproblems; freshness/UNKNOWN and delta repair matter only on real 15-step BrowserGym/WebArena trajectories, not 6-step TodoMVC mocks (prior)

Workflow compilation: mechanisms encoding preconditions, parameter slots, postcondition guards and direct API/tool bypass compress exploration more than browser replay — motivates WebAPI endpoint+method+auth mining as higher-leverage than retrieval complementarity (prior)

Context salience / attentional anchoring: agents reuse superficially similar fragments even when stale, causing false accepts without verification and calibration (ECE, UNKNOWN) — motivates false_accept<=0.10 and calibration gates (prior)

Exploration/exploitation and caching verification: deterministic script caching (BrowserUse, computer-use-cache) already productizes exact replay at 99% cost reduction; SPIDER wedge must be parameterized, state-conditioned, freshness-gated reuse with verification/repair economics (prior)
